scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Whoa, long time no see! But weren't you supposed to be dead?

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Ah, you must have been reborn. Well, I'm glad to have you back.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I don't think you're ready to learn magic yet. Why don't you go finish learning the Basic Skills first?

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Take your time. The more you learn, the more ready you'll be to learn magic again.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Well, since you have passed the Mage test once, I will not question your qualification. You want to have your magic skills back immediately, don't you?

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Wow, for some reason, you look way better than you did before. Anyway, I believe you will do a better job being a Mage as well.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Is there anything more I can help you with? If not, why don't you go test your skills? The world is waiting for you~!

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: What, are you interested in the Mage guild? I didn't want to tell you this, but you don't belong here.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: I am not sure why you're still standing in front of me, but I can tell that you're not meant to be a Mage.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
Hey, haven't you realized? You're already a Mage, silly!
One of these days you'll realize the power inside of you when you can make Fire with your mind!

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Hey~ C'mon. Quit playing games. You can't be a Mage because you already have another Job.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Hey?
I want to be a Mage
What are the requirements to be a Mage?
Nothing, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Wanna be a Mage? Eh...

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
Hey, look at you! You're kinda cute~! Not my type though...
Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage?

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
Oooh, you're such a hot babe~!
I like girls like you~
Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage?
I want to be a Mage.
Nothing, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Whaaaaat~?! Right after you tell me that you wanna become a Mage, you change your mind?! Be a bit more decisive!

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
Oh, man your Basic Skill Level doesn't reach enough to be a Mage.
Go back and level up your Basic Skill.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
Alright.. sign the application form.... Wow~ you have good handwriting! Ahh, okay. That's enough.
You are... {0}.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
Hmm I can see that you've tried hard in your own way. Though it seems to be a little clumsy, but well I think it's okay!
Good! Always sticking to the basics is the best! I will transform you right away.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
Hahh..! You are now a Mage, one of our colleagues!
We welcome you to the Mage Guild, our new friend!

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
'Welcome to the Mage Guild~'
Congratulations on becoming a member of the Mage Guild! Go for it!

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
I'd be happy to explain the requirements for a pretty girl like you!

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: First of all, you have to reach Novice Job Level 10 and learn all of the Basic Skills.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text:
In the past, there was a complicated potion making test. Because of that, we'd lost an aplicant slowly.
So, we decided to accept all aplicants who meet the basic requirements.

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Don't hesitate. Just be a magician!

scripts.speaker: Mage Guildsman
scripts.text: Nothing...?
